verdict.rationale: OCI documents that its APIs are typical REST APIs, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. Having REST APIs, SDKs, a CLI and a Terraform provider is adjacent to the story and does not deliver a machine-readable spec download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
